items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I went down to Burris and Boydwood most of the time. That's most of the way I played it.

ctx.x: Did you have any long engagement in any certain place?
I went down to Burris and Boydwood most of the time. That's most of the way I played it. Burris, Boydwood, Venus, all that. That was all my work at that time. Boyd, that's all that, I don't know.
